Shocking Blast 4: This weapon arcs with deadly electricity, dealing 4d6 Electric damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Electric damage on a critical hit.
Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Doublestrike 11%: Passive: 11% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
